subject: c-info
title: C.INFO.------PROJ.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 291 (WI-7). C-INFO (composite information) is the subject; PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis) and PROG-EXT-FT (progressional extended functionalism). From MT-IF-DB: INFO-DE (information degrees). From PROG-EXT-FT: PART (participation), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of", and TH-CONT (thrust continuance). From INFO-DE: INFO-F (information focus). From PART: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From INFO-F: ATTN (attraction), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion".
